attributes.comment: Accumulated over the 6 hour window containing this step, which restarts every 6 hours of forecast lead time: the window is 6 hours long at lead times divisible by 6 and shorter at every other lead time (1 to 5 hours where lead times are hourly, 3 hours where they are 3-hourly). Subtracting the value at an earlier lead time with the same window start gives the exact total between those two lead times. NaN over water, where this quantity does not apply.
